_about: Borderless windowed when nothing else provides it (the owner, 26 Oct 2026: "I wouldn't mind if FLvibed could add borderless windowed support if no currently detected mod does it by itself"). One row in the controller's SYSTEM section after fluf_windows; read at the game's start (controller\src\host\winmode.cpp, docs\kb\display.md 'Window mode path').

rows.label: Borderless window
rows.help: The game as a window without frame that covers its monitor at the monitor's resolution - never exclusive fullscreen, so Alt+Tab is instant. Auto (default): only when nothing else provides it (HD Edition does: the row says BY THE GAME (HDE)); Always: also then; Off: the game's own window mode. The row says who provides it now. With FLUF, Alt+Enter switches between it and a bordered window. Takes effect at the next start.
